author: China Insights
description:
Over the course of just 48 hours, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio faced four separate congressional hearings — navigating criticism, political attacks, and some of the most unusual exchanges on Capitol Hill this year.

From debates over foreign policy and energy sanctions to viral moments involving campaign politics, presidential meetings, and even a discussion about shoes, the hearings revealed more than just policy disagreements. They offered a window into how modern political theatre works in Washington.

In this episode, we break down the most talked-about moments, examine the contrasting dynamics between the House and Senate, and explore why Rubio has emerged as one of the most influential figures in American foreign policy today.

title: Marco Rubio vs Congress: 48 Hours of Political Firestorms Explained
